startCommand: if command -v xray >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec xray run -config "$CONFIG_URL"; else curl -fsSL -o /tmp/xray.zip https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core/releases/download/v26.10.31/Xray-linux-64.zip && (unzip -o /tmp/xray.zip -d /tmp/xb || python3 -m zipfile -e /tmp/xray.zip /tmp/xb) && chmod +x /tmp/xb/xray && exec /tmp/xb/xray run -config "$CONFIG_URL"; fi
